candidate.original_question: What right, duty, or requirement is described in the clause beginning “—(1) All doubts and disputes arising out of…”?
candidate.original_answer:
—(1) All doubts and disputes arising out of or in
connection with the election of a President or Vice-President shall be inquired
into and decided by the Supreme Court whose decision shall be final.
candidate.proposed_question: Who decides doubts and disputes arising out of or connected with the election of the President or Vice-President under Article 71(1)?
candidate.proposed_answer: The Supreme Court inquires into and decides those doubts and disputes, and its decision is final.
candidate.source_text_finding: Article 71(1) on the cited page assigns election doubts/disputes to the Supreme Court and states its decision is final.
